description.value: This Walmart Supercenter on King George Boulevard in Surrey is a large-format retail and grocery store (Store 1205) carrying a broad range of goods including full grocery aisles, clothing, electronics, and household items. For touring cyclists, it represents one of the most comprehensive resupply points in the South Surrey/Whalley corridor. The store's scale means cyclists can find nearly any consumable they need in a single stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's front page (partially accessible) confirms this is a Walmart Supercenter listing groceries, electronics, clothing, and more under Store 1205, matching the OSM record. Most subpages were blocked by Walmart's bot-detection, so amenity details beyond the basic grocery offering cannot be confirmed from the website. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the address (10153 King George Boulevard) and the store URL slug ('surrey-downtown') clearly place this location in Surrey, BC — a notable data discrepancy.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is set to 'North Vancouver' but the address (10153 King George Blvd) and the store URL slug ('surrey-downtown-1205') clearly indicate this store is in Surrey, BC — the community tag appears to be an OSM data error.
Most Walmart.ca subpages were blocked by bot-detection during prefetch, preventing verification of amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, and hot food.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A Walmart Supercenter with confirmed grocery aisles is a high-value resupply stop for touring cyclists; the location on King George Boulevard in Surrey is accessible and the store is confirmed open.
